comparison.objective: Install and secure a rack rail; record disconnects and removes a drawer from two slides.
comparison.physical_skill: Depress a tab while inserting spring prongs, then extend and fasten versus simultaneous opposite-sense lever actuation while pulling and supporting a drawer.
comparison.success_condition: Rail remains installed at matching rack units with complete spring extension and screws; record requires the drawer fully separated, set down, and released.
comparison.reason: Both involve long hardware and latches, but installation through prong alignment and fastening is meaningfully different from synchronized slide release and extraction.
